title: PhysioNIRS 0.5.1
text: Fixed pruneChannels() / quality-contract validation R >= 4.4.0: R 4.4 changed .atomic(NULL) TRUE FALSE, .nirs_quality_plain() wrongly rejected governed quality results carrying NULL optional-parameter sentinels (e.g. step_seconds = NULL) ‘stale malformed’. NULL now handled explicitly plain leaf (pre-4.4 behaviour). Made MBLL reference-fixture self-consistency check portable: stored intensity recomputed optical density via exp() (transcendental whose last bit toolchain-dependent), exact (tolerance = 0) compare now tolerance = 1e-12 (~2300x measured cross-platform noise). File-hash governance unaffected.

title: PhysioNIRS 0.5.0
text: Add source-bound scalp-coupling, PHOEBE-style peak-power, spectral SNR quality metrics auditable mark/drop channel pruning. Add synchronous governed HbO neurofeedback controller publishes atomic multi-target updates PhysioStream biofeedback scopes.

title: PhysioNIRS 0.4.0
text: Add source-bound short-channel identification, centred nearest/short-separation regression, explicit physiology-band extraction, GLM-ready nuisance-design matrices.

title: PhysioNIRS 0.3.0
text: Add governed motion-artifact detection, TDDR, shift-invariant db2 wavelet correction, cubic-spline correction.

title: PhysioNIRS 0.2.0
text: Add governed natural-log optical density, differential pathlength, extinction-coefficient, modified Beer-Lambert conversions.

title: PhysioNIRS 0.1.0
text: Add strict SNIRF v1.1 continuous-wave read/write support. Add governed measurement-list source-detector distance helpers.
